query:
SELECT 
  JSON_EXTRACT(sliceMetadata, '$.industry') as industry,
  COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003, 1530001)
GROUP BY industry
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 30;
